title: Characterization of safe computation segments
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, $F$ a set of states (including the possible halting state), and $P$ a predicate on work-tape head positions. For configurations $a,b$ and a time $t$, the segment from $a$ to $b$ is safe exactly when $M$ reaches $b$ from $a$ after $t$ steps, every configuration from time $0$ through time $t$ has state outside $F$, and every such configuration satisfies $P$ of its work-tape head positions.
hypotheses_covered: A predicate $P$ on work-tape head positions
